_comment: PLACEHOLDER TEAM. These are not real people. The names are invented and
nobody listed here has agreed to anything — replace this file with the
real organising team before the site is public.
The ROLES are safe to keep: they are the jobs a DevFest actually has, and
they are what the page is really for. It is the names that must change.
Editing: change the file, commit, and the next deploy carries it. A squad
with nobody in it is skipped, and a roster with nobody in it at all still
renders the page with an honest line instead of an empty grid, so you can
empty this out and fill it in a person at a time.
Every field except image is required. Leave image out and the card falls
back to a tinted placeholder with the person's initials.
